label: #3637339: Skip link does not follow configured focus color, pinned core
description: Compare the keyboard-focused skip link with the configured focus color, independently from accent color, in light, dark and emulated forced colors.
status: DRAFT: MR !17818 corrects configured color; viewport-edge outline clipping remains; human review required

steps.text: Use a plain Standard install with Default Admin as the administration theme. Log in to both sites and open the Default Admin appearance settings.
steps.lookFor: Both sites render the same settings form.

steps.text: Set identical appearance, accent color and focus color through each site's settings form, then save. Test focus color independently from accent color.
steps.lookFor: Record the exact selected options on both sites.

steps.text: Turn focus mirroring off. Reload each page and press Tab to reach Skip to main content independently. Use the evaluator's paired screenshots to compare both genuinely focused states.
steps.lookFor: A visible focus indicator matching the selected focus configuration, including at the viewport edge.

steps.text: Press Enter on the skip link and inspect its main-content destination. Repeat in light, dark, forced colors, narrow viewports and RTL.
steps.lookFor: The intended main-content target is reached without keyboard or scrolling regressions. Forced colors and viewer RTL are simulations.

expected: The skip link uses the configured focus indicator and remains visible and keyboard operable.
actual: The baseline uses the browser focus ring. MR !17818 matches the configured theme outline, but its top and logical-start bounds extend 6px outside the viewport.

observe.label: Does the focused skip link follow the saved focus color, rather than merely the accent color?
Is the full focus indicator visible at the viewport edge?
Does Enter move navigation to the intended main-content target?

coverage.note: Environment coverage only: consult EVIDENCE.md for saved appearance/accent/focus combinations and WebKit keyboard qualification. Latest and pinned runtime coverage are separate.

description: DRAFT local experiment, separate from MR !17818: assess token-derived top and logical-start clearance for the focused skip link.
status: DRAFT: captured local clearance proposal passes 19 configuration/environment combinations; human review required

steps.text: Use plain Standard installs with Default Admin. Before intentionally contains MR !17818; After contains the same MR followed by the separate clearance patch.
steps.lookFor: Both sites use core ecb483ff6d4b and the declared patch stacks, not a pristine Before.

steps.text: Save identical appearance, accent and focus choices through both settings forms. Disable focus mirroring, reload each document, and press Tab independently.
steps.lookFor: Both indicators use the configured color. Before clips the ring at top/start; After provides token-derived clearance.

steps.text: Press Enter on each skip link. Compare the subsequent focus sequence and scroll position, then repeat representative narrow, forced-colors and RTL cases.
steps.lookFor: Main content is reached without changes to the measured navigation, control geometry or scroll. Direction and forced colors are browser simulations.

expected: The configured MR focus indicator remains fully inside the viewport after adding token-derived clearance.
actual: The unchanged MR has a 4px outline plus 2px offset at zero top/start position; measured bounds extend 6px beyond the viewport.

observe.label: Is the complete focused outline visible at top and logical start without moving other content?
Does Enter still reach main content, without a new scrolling or layout regression?
